import sys

MOD = 998244353

def pow_mod(a, b, mod):
    if b < 0:
        b = b % (mod - 1) + mod - 1
    ans = 1
    mul = a
    while b > 0:
        if b & 1:
            ans = ans * mul % mod
        mul = mul * mul % mod
        b >>= 1
    return ans

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    k = int(next(it))
    
    fact = [0] * (n + 1)
    inv = [0] * (n + 1)
    fact[0] = 1
    for i in range(n):
        fact[i + 1] = fact[i] * (i + 1) % MOD
    inv[n] = pow_mod(fact[n], MOD - 2, MOD)
    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        inv[i - 1] = inv[i] * i % MOD
    
    def comb(i, j):
        if j < 0 or j > i:
            return 0
        return fact[i] * inv[j] % MOD * inv[i - j] % MOD
    
    if k == 0:
        print(fact[n])
    elif k > n:
        print(0)
    else:
        k2 = k
        k3 = n - k2
        ans = 0
        for i in range(1, k3 + 1):
            tmp = comb(k3, i) * pow_mod(i, n, MOD) % MOD
            if (k3 - i) & 1:
                ans = (ans - tmp) % MOD
            else:
                ans = (ans + tmp) % MOD
        ans = (ans % MOD + MOD) % MOD
        ans = ans * 2 % MOD
        ans = ans * comb(n, k2) % MOD
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
